annotations.title: Tidy Playground nodes or a group

description: Arrange loose nodes as a block, or re-lay out a group’s children, as one revision-checked, idempotent, non-paid revision (the tidy operation of playground_canvas_apply_operations). Give nodeIds or groupId.

expectedRevision.description: Current canvas revision from canvas_read; on revision_conflict, read again and rebuild the change.

groupId.description: Existing canvas group ID to arrange.

idempotencyKey.description: Unique key for this request; reuse only when retrying the identical request after a lost response. Use a new key after quoting or changing inputs.

nodeIds.description: IDs of the existing canvas nodes to use for this action.

projectId.description: ID of the Playground project chosen for this task; obtain it from project creation, an explicit project link or current context.

name: playground_canvas_arrange

summary.description: Human-readable summary of the applied canvas operations.
